title: Broader dream-content wave (DreamTok) beyond lucid dreaming for EN TikTok
need: Content and audio companions for exploring dreams, astral projection and dream interpretation broadly, not just lucid dreaming

audience.description: English-speaking TikTok users interested in dream culture broadly, including lucid dreaming, astral projection, and dream interpretation

consumption_context: Evening/night scrolling, before sleep or upon waking, engaging with dream-related content

evidence.statement: A 'DreamTok' discovery hub exists on TikTok covering dream-related content including lucid dreaming, astral projection, and dream interpretation as a broader umbrella than lucid dreaming alone.
A broader 'DreamTok' content wave could expand engagement beyond the existing lucid-dreaming cluster into related dream/astral-projection interests.
evidence.rationale: The discovery hub bundles multiple dream-adjacent themes together, suggesting audience appetite spans beyond lucid dreaming specifically.
evidence.test_idea: Publish instrumental tracks framed for 'dream journaling' or 'astral projection' alongside existing lucid-dream content and compare engagement.

evaluation.summary: A broader 'DreamTok' wave spanning lucid dreaming, astral projection, and dream interpretation is observed to exist as a discovery hub on TikTok, but supporting evidence is limited to one medium-confidence observation and one low-confidence hypothesis about expansion. No playlists or pages currently match this cluster, and only tangentially adjacent artists (37) are available, so a new asset would be required. Given the emerging durability, thin evidence, and lack of asset fit, this remains a speculative opportunity worth light exploration rather than immediate investment.
